designationHistory.indexText: ns hunted here for thousands of years and the island was among the first areas settled by Europeans in the "New World." Established in December 1962, the refuge is a major feeding and resting place for migratory and wintering waterfowl on Maryland’s famed “Eastern Shore.” The varied habitats on Eastern Neck NWR, including brackish tidal marsh, forest, cropland, grassland, and open water impoundmen
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
